title: A member can pass the gym's own workout plans to anyone outside the gym
what: Plans the gym sends to its members show as folders on the Workout tab, and the Share routine and Share folder buttons work on them like on any other folder. A member can send the whole gym plan as text or as a file that any app user, including people who never joined the gym, can open and follow.
expected: The owner decides whether gym plans may leave the gym. If not, sharing a gym folder is hidden or the shared copy says which gym it came from.
how_often: whenever a member chooses to share a gym plan
fix_line: Ask the owner; if plans should stay in the gym, hide Share on gym folders or stamp the gym's name on the copy

title: Exercise and routine names from someone else would go into the AI coach note as plain facts
what: The AI coach note (hidden today: the coach switch is off in code) sends the workout's exercise names to the AI as trusted facts, with no fence saying they are only names. Names can come from a stranger's Hevy share link, a shared routine file or the gym's plans, so a crafted name could steer the one-line note if the coach is ever switched on. The note only reaches the member who logged it.
expected: Names sent to the AI are marked as data the AI must not follow, and cut to a short length, before the coach is switched on.
who: members, only if the coach is switched on
how_often: never today; every coach note once switched on
fix_line: Fence and shorten exercise names in the AI facts before turning the coach on
